title: Gonzalo:
title_short: Reel · Gonzalo · Now I Must Share This Gift
headline: He went to prison at 17 and felt like a spectator in his own life. A Freedom to Choose workshop gave him compassion. Now he goes back in and gives it away.
story: Gonzalo was locked up at 17. At about 32, inside Valley State Prison, a friend invited him to an FTC weekend. People from the outside sat with the men, shook hands, broke bread. He dropped the titles “inmate” and “gang member” and claimed his own name. Today he is out, works as a facilitator, and volunteers with FTC. The compassion he got inside is a gift he now passes on. It is not about his crime, his sentence or how hard prison is.

Loops: L1 “What does not being in your own life mean?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:20. L2 “What changed him?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:30. Stakes: 17 years old, prison, a life run by labels. The workshop is where he takes his name back.
